purpose: REQUIRED-FUNCTIONALITY GRAPH (owner-directed 2026-06-27). Each requirement is a NODE that says 'surface/page X requires functionality Y'; its `check` is a deterministic EDGE to the code that must satisfy it (a pattern in a file, resolved against the code/grep graph with zero LLM). The checker (scripts/check_required_functionality.py) verifies every edge: a `satisfied` requirement is REGRESSION-GUARDED (if its code disappears the gate fails); a `gap` requirement is the live remediation backlog (reported, not failing, until implemented). This is how we can say 'this page requires this functionality' and CHECK it against the structure. Seeded from the wiring-review (wf_52602c56-586). serves_truth=false.

check_types.regex_in_file: {file, pattern, expect:present|absent} — pattern present/absent in the file
